purpose_of_this_fixture: Calibration fixture for the block-export shred case (REAL-CALL-LESSONS C58a; BUILD-PLAN 4.2 row s14). A discovery call with an event services company, exported as a block transcript: one unit per line, a start-only stamp, a label and a paragraph. The export is dishonestly clean. It marks nothing, yet its stamps are unpadded and variable-width, five pairs of adjacent units share a stamp, one fragment carries an earlier stamp than the unit before it, forty units begin lowercase, fifty-seven units are four words or fewer, a single-letter unit ('s') sits mid-sentence under the wrong label, the call's headline figure is split across three units and two labels, and one 174-word unit under one client's label holds our question, a second client's answer and a vocative addressing the label. The key asserts the repair, not only the reading: every shredded sentence is re-joined to its true owner in the intake record and cited from a single unit or refused, the three-unit figure is reconstructed for its owner as a [Q/recon] and graded from the client's own whole-token confirmation, the single-letter unit is a boundary artifact with its owner unresolved and is never re-attributed, the inverted stamp is kept in file order and nothing is reordered, the colliding stamps are recorded and never used to order or merge, the composite block is split into side-only segments with nothing attributed to the labelled speaker, and both detectors run with only the composite splitter firing. Beside the intake assertions the 25 fields grade the call itself: Discovery complete with R4 and R5 met-with-residual, R11 missing and R12 partial, three excavated pains, one pain-level check not obtainable from this room, and a Work Management build for shows, kit, crew and check-in with the client's hire system left as the book of record.
transcript_format: Block export: 415 units on 829 lines, one unit per line separated by blank lines, in the form 'M:SS Label: text'. Stamps are start-only, unpadded and variable-width (0:02 to 59:07, no hours field, no milliseconds), and not strictly monotonic: five adjacent pairs share a stamp (7:58, 17:10, 19:34, 26:28, 32:28, always two different labels) and one unit carries an earlier stamp than the unit before it (31:09 after 31:12). No participant header, no call date, no end times. Four labels, a role word and three full names: 'Consultant', 'Meera Ganguly', 'Dermot Shanley', 'Aileen Rusnak'. About 6,450 spoken words; client share about 60 percent by words (Meera 28.5, Dermot 17.5, Aileen 14.3), below the healthy band because our side asks many short questions; the longest own-side unit is 72 words (L21). Longest unit 174 words (L205), 96 seconds to the next stamp, the one composite block. One adjacent same-label pair (L751/L753). Shred counts: 40 units begin lowercase, 32 lack terminal punctuation, 57 are four words or fewer (13.7 percent). Bracketed cues: [laughs] four times, [crosstalk] once; no ellipsis anywhere; ASCII only; LF line endings. Currency is pounds. Every location in this key is 'L<line>, M:SS Label' with the stamp and label exactly as printed on that line, because a stamp alone is not unique in this file; a segment inside the composite block adds '(composite block, side-only)'. Every quote sits inside exactly one line. Weekday clues (Friday the second, Tuesday the sixth, the budget round in the first week of November) fit a call in the last days of September 2026; the date is not stated.
